preconditions.expression: head is None or (isinstance(head, ListNode) and head.val >= 0 and head.next is None or (isinstance(head.next, ListNode) and head.next.val >= head.val))
preconditions.description: The linked list is either empty or consists of nodes with non-decreasing values.

postconditions.expression: is_balanced(return_value) and is_bst(return_value, float('-inf'), float('inf')) and contains_all_nodes(return_value, head)
postconditions.description: The returned tree is balanced, is a binary search tree, and contains all nodes from the linked list.
